title: CAEPF — Cadastro de Atividade Econômica da Pessoa Física
description: Registration of individuals who employ workers (replaced the CEI for them).

format.summary: Formats a CAEPF (Cadastro de Atividade Econômica da Pessoa Física) number according to the official mask.
description: Formats a CAEPF with the mask `000.000.000/000-00`.
- The mask is applied as far as the digits go; `options.pad` left-pads with zeros to 14 digits first.

isValid.summary: Validates a CAEPF (Cadastro de Atividade Econômica da Pessoa Física) number.
description: Validates a CAEPF: 14 digits, the 9-digit CPF base of the holder, a 3-digit sequence and 2 check digits.
- Both check digits follow the CNPJ modulus 11; the resulting pair is then shifted by 12, wrapping around 100.
- A base whose digits are all the same is rejected.
- The value may be a number or a string, masked as `000.000.000/000-00` or not.

parse.summary: Removes CAEPF (Cadastro de Atividade Econômica da Pessoa Física) formatting characters and returns only digits.
description: Removes CAEPF formatting and keeps only digits, capped to 14 digits.

tests.name: caps-length
tests.note: reference truncates to the 14 characters of the document; asserted by the reference (JS) unit tests
